create_wikipedia_dataset: create a wikipedia json_dataset instance that loads wikidump_lines.json with text_key and loose_json settings
create_webtext_dataset: create a webtext json_dataset instance that loads data.json with text_key and loose_json settings
use_named_corpora_registry: use the NAMED_CORPORA dict to look up wikipedia or webtext dataset classes by string key
review_wikipedia_class: review the wikipedia class that extends json_dataset with preset PATH and text_key arguments
review_webtext_class: review the webtext class that extends json_dataset with preset PATH and loose_json arguments
